title: Simple Challenge
description: A very basic CTF challenge to learn the platform. Find the hidden flag on the internal web server.

levels.title: Scenario Briefing
levels.content:
Welcome, analyst

Your task is to access the internal web server at 10.10.20.10 and find the hidden flag.

levels.title: Connect to Your Workstation
levels.cloud_content: SSH into the student VM student-vm using the credentials provided by the platform. Submit the passkey to continue.
levels.local_content: SSH into the student VM student-vm. Submit the passkey to continue.

levels.title: Mission 1 — Find the flag
levels.content: There is an internal web server running on 10.10.20.10. Connect to it and find the hidden flag.
levels.solution:
1. Connect to the student VM.
2. Fetch the web page: curl http://10.10.20.10
3. Look at the HTML source to find the flag in an HTML comment.

hints.title: How to connect
hints.content: Use curl to fetch the webpage: curl http://10.10.20.10

hints.title: Where is the flag
hints.content: The flag is hidden as an HTML comment in the source code.
